name: genkit-reeval
description: Does Genkit's agent tooling help coding agents? A reeval study of Genkit's rules, MCP server, skills, docs and TSDoc.

scripts.canary: sh -c 'since=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ); reeval run --config reeval.oracle.config.ts --profile canary "$@"; tsx evals/canary-check.ts --since "$since"' canary
scripts.probe:canary: sh -c 'since=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ); reeval run --config reeval.probes.oracle.config.ts --profile canary "$@"; tsx evals/canary-check.ts --since "$since"' probe-canary
